description.value: Mr. Tubbs has been a family-owned ice cream parlour and arcade in Victoria since 1989, offering 48 flavours served in cones, cups, sundaes, and banana splits alongside savoury snacks like grilled cheese and hot dogs. The space doubles as a family fun zone with 25¢ redemption arcade games, making it a lively mid-ride treat stop — especially appealing to cyclists traveling with kids. Custom ice cream cakes and birthday party packages round out the offering.

bike_parking_detail: 3 racks within 100m: ground_slots (2 spaces, covered) at 3m; ground_slots (2 spaces, covered) at 10m; informal (covered) at 20m. Total: 4 spaces.
